stem_book: The range of f(x) = [1 + sin x] + [2 + sin(x/2)] + [3 + sin(x/3)] + … + [n + sin(x/n)], ∀ x ∈ [0, π], where [·] denotes the greatest integer function, is (a) {(n² + n − 2)/2, n(n+1)/2} (b) {n(n+1)/2} (c) {(n² + n − 2)/2, n(n+1)/2, (n² + n + 2)/2} (d) {n(n+1)/2, (n² + n + 2)/2}
work: f = n(n+1)/2 + Σ[sin(x/k)], sin(x/k) ∈ [0,1], = 1 only at x = π/2 (k=1) or x = π (k=2), never together ⇒ extra term 0 or 1
